# Contributing

Thanks for helping out.
Bug fixes, features, plugin work, and docs
improvements are all welcome.
This page covers the setup and the few
conventions that make changes easy to review.

## Getting started

```bash
uv venv
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
```

Python 3.12+ and `uv` are the baseline.
Node 24+ or Bun is needed for
the web UI and plugin bundles.

## Build the front-end

The web UI is a Next.js app that FastAPI serves as a static export:

```bash
cd berg_agents/ui/webapp
npm install   # or: bun install
npm run build
```

Plugins with a UI ship a built bundle too:

```bash
cd berg_plugins/<plugin>
npm install
npm run build:ui
```

## Making changes

- Keep a pull request to one change.
  Small PRs get reviewed faster.
- `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` should pass.
  Public
  functions, classes, and methods get docstrings.
- Tests run offline with mocks (`pytest -q`).
  `ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS`
  stays `False` in `tests/conftest.py` --- no live models in tests.
- Update the docs when you change something user-facing.
  Docs are
  Quarto `.qmd` files under `docs/`; the root `README.md` is generated
  from `docs/index.qmd`, so edit the `.qmd` and never `README.md`.

## Where things live

  | Area               | Location                        |
  | ------------------ | ------------------------------- |
  | Harness and agents | `berg_agents/agents/`           |
  | Tool specs         | `berg_agents/agents/factory.py` |
  | Web API and TUI    | `berg_agents/ui/`               |
  | Web front-end      | `berg_agents/ui/webapp/app/`    |
  | Plugin system      | `berg_agents/plugin_system/`    |
  | Providers          | `berg_agents/providers/`        |
  | Config             | `berg_agents/config/`           |
  | Plugins            | `berg_plugins/<plugin-id>/`     |
  | Docs               | `docs/` (Quarto `.qmd`)         |

## A few things worth knowing

- Config resolves through one function,
  `berg_agents/config/paths.py::resolve_config_dir`.
  Use it instead of
  hardcoding a directory name.
- Models carry their own provider, `baseURL`, and `apiKey` in the
  `providers` block of `bergagents.jsonc`.
  There is no global provider
  flag.
- Plugins ship a built JS bundle; the host mounts it at runtime and
  never imports plugin source.
  See
  [`plugins/PLUGIN-UI.qmd`](plugins/PLUGIN-UI.qmd) and
  [`plugins/MANIFEST.qmd`](plugins/MANIFEST.qmd).
- Memory lives at `{config}/memory/MEMORY.md` and is injected into every
  request.
  Compaction is registered before the memory capability --- that
  order matters.
- The session store opens a SQLite connection per operation.
  Caching a
  connection across threads breaks under `asyncio.to_thread`.

## Pull requests

1. Branch from `main`.
2. Describe what changed and why, and include test results or manual
   checks you ran.
3. Wait for review before merging.

If you are unsure about a change, open an issue first and we can agree
on an approach before you write code.
